title: Giant Steps · 三颗星的轨道
title_en: Giant Steps · Orbits of Three Stars

lines.zh: 1959 年春天，纽约。萨克斯手约翰·柯川走进录音室，带来一首让所有乐手都心惊的曲子。
lines.en: Spring 1959, New York. Saxophonist John Coltrane walked into the studio with a tune that unnerved every musician who saw it.

clauses.text: 萨克斯手约翰柯川走进录音室
带来一首让所有乐手都心惊的曲子

lines.zh: 它叫 Giant Steps —— 巨人的脚步。
lines.en: It was called Giant Steps.

lines.zh: 速度接近每分钟 290 拍，和弦几乎每两拍就换一次，而且每一次，都跳向一个遥远的调。
lines.en: Nearly 290 beats per minute, a new chord almost every two beats, and each one leaps to a distant key.

clauses.text: 速度接近每分钟二百九十拍
和弦几乎每两拍就换一次

lines.zh: 连录音中的钢琴手汤米·弗拉纳根，也只能小心翼翼地弹出稀疏的音符。
lines.en: Even the pianist on the session, Tommy Flanagan, could only pick his way through with sparse notes.

clauses.text: 连录音中的钢琴手汤米弗拉纳根
也只能小心翼翼地弹出稀疏的音符

lines.zh: 但在这看似混乱的表面之下，藏着一个极其简单、也极其美的秩序。
lines.en: Yet beneath the apparent chaos lies an order that is remarkably simple, and remarkably beautiful.

clauses.text: 但在这看似混乱的表面之下

scenes.name: 五度圈 The Circle of Fifths

lines.zh: 先看普通的爵士和声。十二个音，可以按五度排成一个圆，叫做五度圈。
lines.en: First, ordinary jazz harmony. The twelve notes can be arranged by fifths into a circle: the circle of fifths.

clauses.text: 可以按五度排成一个圆

lines.zh: 爵士乐最常见的进行是 ii–V–I。比如在 C 大调里：Dm7，到 G7，再回到 Cmaj7。
lines.en: Jazz's most common progression is the ii–V–I. In C major: Dm7, to G7, and home to Cmaj7.

lines.zh: 在五度圈上，它一步一步往回走，每一步都很近、很自然，耳朵始终知道「家」在哪里。
lines.en: On the circle it walks home step by step. Every step is close and natural; the ear always knows where home is.

clauses.text: 耳朵始终知道家在哪里

lines.zh: 在一首普通的标准曲里，一个调往往会停留好几个小节，才慢慢走到隔壁的调。
lines.en: In a typical standard, a key lingers for several bars before drifting to its neighbour.

clauses.text: 在一首普通的标准曲里
一个调往往会停留好几个小节

scenes.name: 三等分八度 Dividing the Octave

lines.zh: 柯川问了一个不同的问题：如果不去邻居家，而是把八度平均切成三份呢？
lines.en: Coltrane asked a different question: instead of visiting the neighbours, what if you cut the octave into three equal parts?

clauses.text: 柯川问了一个不同的问题
而是把八度平均切成三份呢

lines.zh: 一个八度有 12 个半音。12 ÷ 3 = 4。四个半音，就是一个大三度。
lines.en: An octave has twelve semitones. Twelve divided by three is four. Four semitones make a major third.

clauses.text: 一个八度有十二个半音

lines.zh: 从 B 出发，向下走一个大三度，到 G；再走一个，到 E♭；再走一个，又回到了 B。
lines.en: Start on B. Down a major third to G. Again, to E-flat. Once more, and you are back at B.

lines.zh: 三个调，在圆上形成一个完美的等边三角形。
lines.en: Three keys form a perfect equilateral triangle on the circle.

clauses.text: 在圆上形成一个完美的等边三角形

lines.zh: 把它放回五度圈，三角形依然是等边的。这意味着，这三个调彼此之间几乎是最远的距离。
lines.en: Put it back on the circle of fifths and the triangle is still equilateral: these three keys are about as far apart as keys can be.

lines.zh: B 大调五个升号，G 大调一个升号，E♭ 大调三个降号。任意两个调的音阶，只有三个音相同。
lines.en: B major has five sharps, G major one, E-flat major three flats. Any two of these scales share only three notes.

lines.zh: 可是突然跳到很远的调，会显得生硬。柯川的办法是：在每个调前面，放上它的属七和弦。
lines.en: But leaping to a distant key sounds abrupt. Coltrane's solution: put each key's dominant seventh chord in front of it.

clauses.text: 可是突然跳到很远的调

lines.zh: D7 把我们带到 G，B♭7 带到 E♭，F♯7 带回 B。
lines.en: D7 pulls us to G, B-flat 7 to E-flat, F-sharp 7 back to B.

lines.zh: 属和弦就像一股引力。每一次跳跃，都有一只手把你稳稳接住。
lines.en: The dominant is like gravity: every leap has a hand to catch you.

clauses.text: 都有一只手把你稳稳接住

lines.zh: 这就是「柯川变化」：三个等距的主音，加上通往它们的属和弦。
lines.en: This is "Coltrane changes": three equidistant tonics, plus the dominants that lead to them.

clauses.text: 加上通往它们的属和弦

scenes.name: 十六小节 The Sixteen Bars

lines.zh: 现在把整首曲子展开。十六个小节。前半段，三个调以大三度向下旋转：B，G，E♭。
lines.en: Now the whole tune: sixteen bars. In the first half, the three keys spin downward by major thirds: B, G, E-flat.

clauses.text: 三个调以大三度向下旋转

lines.zh: 后半段，每个调都由一组 ii–V 引入，方向反转，以大三度向上攀升。
lines.en: In the second half, each key is entered through a ii–V, and the direction reverses, climbing by major thirds.

clauses.text: 每个调都由一组二五引入

lines.zh: 我们放慢速度，完整地听一遍。注意圆上的光点，在三个顶点之间不停跳跃。
lines.en: Let's slow down and listen once through. Watch the light leap between the three vertices.

clauses.text: 在三个顶点之间不停跳跃

lines.zh: 在这样的和声上即兴，靠的不只是灵感，更是准备。柯川练习了大量的音型。
lines.en: Improvising over these changes takes preparation as much as inspiration. Coltrane practised countless patterns.

clauses.text: 柯川练习了大量的音型

lines.zh: 最著名的是「1-2-3-5」：根音、二级、三级、五级。四个八分音符，正好填满两拍。
lines.en: The most famous is "1-2-3-5": root, second, third, fifth. Four eighth notes, exactly two beats.

lines.zh: 在 Bmaj7 上，是 B、C♯、D♯、F♯；换到 D7，就是 D、E、F♯、A。
lines.en: On Bmaj7: B, C-sharp, D-sharp, F-sharp. On D7: D, E, F-sharp, A.

lines.zh: 另一个关键是三音和七音，它们决定和弦的颜色。好的旋律线，会用最小的移动把它们连起来。
lines.en: Another key: the third and seventh, which give each chord its colour. A good line connects them with the smallest possible motion.

lines.zh: 再加上半音的经过音和包围音，旋律就能在飞驰的和弦之间顺滑地流动。
lines.en: Add chromatic passing and enclosure notes, and the line flows smoothly between racing chords.

clauses.text: 再加上半音的经过音和包围音
旋律就能在飞驰的和弦之间

lines.zh: 下面这段即兴，由程序按照这些规则生成。先用慢速听两遍。每个音的颜色，代表它所属的调。
lines.en: The following solo was generated by a program that follows these rules. First, two choruses at a slow tempo. Each note's colour shows the key it belongs to.

clauses.text: 由程序按照这些规则生成

lines.zh: 现在，回到柯川的速度。
lines.en: Now, back to Coltrane's tempo.

lines.zh: Giant Steps 之后，柯川把这套方法用在许多曲子上，比如 Countdown 和 26-2。很快，他又走向更自由、更灵性的音乐。
lines.en: After Giant Steps, Coltrane applied the method to many tunes, such as Countdown and 26-2. Soon he moved on to freer, more spiritual music.

clauses.text: 柯川把这套方法用在许多曲子上

lines.zh: 但这首曲子留下的启示，至今仍在每一位爵士乐手心中回响：秩序足够深的地方，自由才真正开始。
lines.en: But its lesson still echoes in every jazz musician: where order runs deep enough, freedom truly begins.

clauses.text: 但这首曲子留下的启示
至今仍在每一位爵士乐手心中回响
